opening.argument: The material promises an allegedly unlimited supply of cryptocurrency and presents the method as immediately usable, claiming a “100% working method” and that the codes are “active and ready to claim right now.” It gives viewers step-by-step instructions to open Binance, select Crypto Box or Red Packet, and enter the displayed codes, while the visible screen shows a BTC code with an “Enter code to claim Red Packet” prompt. It further directs viewers to an external Telegram channel advertising daily codes and asks them to submit a Binance Pay ID for a chance at a personal gift. Together, these features create a concrete promotional flow involving cryptocurrency claims, external-channel participation, and personal payment information.

citations.quote: I’m showing you the 100% working method to claim unlimited Binance Red Packets and Crypto Box codes for 1 April, 2026.
these codes are active and ready to claim right now!
Comment your Binance Pay ID below for a chance to receive a personal gift!
